defects: Hypotheses (nonneg, antitone, integrable) are stated globally over all of ℝ instead of restricted to Ici 0 / Ioi 0 as in the gold (AntitoneOn f (Ici 0), IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0), nonneg only on Ioi 0)

Requiring Integrable f volume (integrability over the whole real line) together with global Antitone and global nonneg is a drastically stronger and nearly degenerate hypothesis (forces f to be identically 0 for antitone nonneg functions to be integrable on all of ℝ), unlike gold which only needs integrability on (0,∞)

Conclusion sums f(n) for n : ℕ (starting at f(0)) rather than gold's f(n+1) (starting at f(1)), so it includes an extra term and does not match the informal statement's 'sum from index 1', changing the mathematical content of the inequality
